meta.name: wordpress
meta.description: Operate connected WordPress sites through the NotFair MCP. Use for WordPress content, posts, pages, media, comments, terms, design, settings, plugins, themes, HTML files, or approved WordPress changes on a NotFair-connected site. Not the local Application-Password CMS setup used by SEO scripts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在对话里管理网站的文章、页面、媒体与站点设置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在经营网站,想不登录后台就能完成日常内容更新
copy.tagline_en: Manage your site's posts, pages, media and settings through chat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to update it without logging into the admin panel.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过 NotFair MCP 操作你已连接的 WordPress 站点，处理文章、页面、媒体等站内内容，也能改动设计、设置、插件和主题。它不用于 SEO 脚本那套本地应用密码 CMS。
howto.when: 当你的请求针对已连接 NotFair 的 WordPress 站点，涉及内容、文章、页面等，或需要在该站点上做已批准的改动时，由它接管。

say.text: 列出这个 WordPress 站点最近的 5 篇文章
say.note: 读取已连接站点的文章列表

say.text: 新建一个页面，标题写「联系我们」
say.note: 在站点上创建页面草稿或发布

say.text: 看看这个站装了哪些插件和主题
say.note: 查看站点插件与主题信息

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude operates your NotFair-connected WordPress sites through the NotFair MCP: content, posts, pages, media, comments, terms, design, settings, plugins, themes, HTML files, and approved changes. It is not the local Application-Password CMS setup used by SEO scripts.
howto.when_en: It takes over when your request targets a NotFair-connected WordPress site — content, posts, pages, media, design, settings, plugins, themes, or an approved change on that site.
